title: ajuga ovalifolia var. calantha
intro: Ajuga ovalifolia var. calantha, commonly known as Bugleweed, is a perennial herb native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Bugleweed include its ability to act as a vasodilator, antispasmodic, and antiseptic, which can help to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Bugleweed include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
